description: This Java class implements PayPal payment processing, including transaction initialization, authorization, capture, and refund, using PayPal API SDKs. It handles PayPal express checkout flow, manages API credentials, and processes payment details for an e-commerce system.

classes.name: PayPalExpressCheckoutPayment
classes.description: Implements PayPal payment module with methods for transaction initialization, authorization, capture, and refund, integrating with PayPal API SDKs.

methods.name: validateModuleConfiguration
methods.description: Validates the provided PayPal API credentials in the configuration.

methods.name: authorize
methods.description: Processes an authorization transaction using PayPal express checkout.

methods.name: initPaypalTransaction
methods.description: Creates a PayPal express checkout transaction, setting up payment details, redirect URLs, and API call to get a checkout token.

methods.name: authorizeAndCapture
methods.description: Processes an authorization and capture transaction via PayPal.

methods.name: refund
methods.description: Processes a refund transaction through PayPal API, supporting partial and full refunds.

methods.name: processTransaction
methods.description: Handles the core logic for executing a PayPal express checkout transaction, including API calls for details and payment execution.

methods.name: capture
methods.description: Captures a previously authorized PayPal transaction.
